newsitem.title: USA: Metromail agrees to acquire database firm.
newsitem.headline: Metromail agrees to acquire database firm.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Atlantes Corp, a consumer database information company, for a combination of stock and cash.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed immediately.
The agreement is subject to a number of conditions, including Atlantes shareholder approval and certain regulatory approvals. The merger is expected to close early in the third quarter of 1997.
Metromail provides database marketing, direct marketing and reference products and services in the United States and United Kingdom.

Atlantes, founded in 1991, obtains, processes and manages information from product registration questionnaires related to the purchase of consumer products. Its database of more than 20 million records has grown more than 50 percent in the past year.

"Atlantes is an outstanding fit with our strategy of providing our clients with unparalleled marketplace insight through the strategic use of information and technology," Metromail Chairman Barton Faber said in a statement.
Atlantes will be part of Metromail's Information Group.
